Title: LinkedIn Learning and Learn365 Deep Integration Guide

Blocks.Text: The following steps outline the Learn365 and LinkedIn Learning integration process:
Authentication: SSO (Azure AD)
Content Discovery: Automated Catalog Sync (All languages)
Reporting: xAPI, AICC
Requirements:
The LinkedIn Learning and Learn365 integration involves the following requirements:

An active Professional or Select Learn365 subscription

An active LinkedIn Learning account

Admin access to LinkedIn Learning

Admin privileges to your Learn365 instance

During the initial configuration, you can configure LinkedIn Learning and Learn365 to establish a secure SAML single sign-on (SSO) connection to ensure seamless access to content. SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the need for manual user registration. SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords

SSO authentication reduces friction for users and administrators by eliminating the
need for manual user registration. SSO ensures learners spend more of their time watching content and less of their time trying to remember usernames and passwords.

The LinkedIn Learning library contains over 20,000 courses, with 20-30 courses
added per week at no extra cost. Learn365 automates this process using the
LinkedIn Learning content APIs, so LMS admins do not have to manually upload new
content packages at regular intervals. After the initial setup, Learn365 will
dynamically refresh the content library on an automated basis. This ensures
new LinkedIn Learning content is available to learners within 24 hours of
release. All content titles and  descriptions are aggregated and indexed to
accommodate keyword searches and support efficient discoverability. Learn365 supports automatic syncing of All languages content libraries.

Learn365 supports both AICC and xAPI reporting. You can optionally configure xAPI to allow LinkedIn Learning to communicate course completions back to Learn365, regardless of how and where the training content is launched. Learners can launch content from within Learn365 or they can view courses directly in LinkedIn Learning.

To configure xAPI reporting for the LinkedIn Learning integration with Learn365 in your tenant, first you'll need to complete some configuration steps in your Azure admin portal, then you'll need to enable xAPI in your LinkedIn Learning admin portal.

We recommend SAML SSO for all enterprise learning platform integrations. You can
configure SSO authentication in your LinkedIn Learning Admin settings. Most
organizations have a centrally-managed identity management solution like Azure
AD, Okta, or ADFS, which can be configured to authenticate users into enterprise
applications like LinkedIn Learning.
Important

Learn365 only supports Azure AD Single Sign-On (SSO). For xAPI reporting with Learn365, SSO must be configured to send User ID - objectidentifier for users otherwise completions will not send back successfully.
To configure Azure SAML SSO review the LinkedIn Learning Azure AD SSO Implementation Guide

Blocks.Section: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
SectionPath: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text: For Learn365 to sync LinkedIn Learning catalog metadata, you first must provision API keys in the LinkedIn Learning admin settings.

Blocks.Section: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
SectionPath: Provision API Keys for Content Catalog Sync
Blocks.Text:
After you log in, if you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin.



From the side navigation menu, select Access content and reports via API.

Click Add application.

In the Add LinkedIn Learning API application screen, provide the name of your learning platform (e.g., "Learn365 Content Sync"), as the application name.

Provide a short description of the integration use case in the application description field. For example, "Learn365 content catalog sync".

Under Choose keys, there are two checkboxes – Content and Report. Select Content.





Click Next and accept the "Terms and Conditions".

Copy the generated Client Id and Client Secret. Use these values later in the "Steps Performed in Learn365" section below.
To configure the LinkedIn Learning Provider in Learn365, take the following steps:
https://helpcenter.elearningforce.com/hc/en-us/articles/11701195542941

In Learn365, on the LinkedIn Learning panel, enter the Application key and the Secret key using the information from the Client Id and Client secret fields respectively in the LinkedIn Learning admin interface. Select Connect
You can now import and manage LinkedIn Learning courses in Learn365

To configure xAPI reporting for the LinkedIn Learning integration with Learn365 in your tenant, you will first need to perform configuration in your Azure admin portal: https://helpcenter.elearningforce.com/hc/en-us/articles/12484668151453, followed by enabling xAPI in your LinkedIn Learning Admin portal

Blocks.Section: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text: Using the information you acquired in Learn365, follow the instructions below to configure LinkedIn Learning:

Blocks.Section: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
SectionPath: Enable xAPI Learner Activity Tracking in LinkedIn Learning
Blocks.Text:
After you log in, if you are not already in the Admin screen, select Go to Admin.



From the side navigation menu, select Configure reporting integrations.

Expand the Configure xAPI section.

Click Add integration.

In the Integration name field, enter "Learn365 Reporting".

In the User Type drop down, select ID.

Copy and paste the Auth URL, Tracking URL, Client ID and Client Secret provided by Learn365 into LinkedIn Learning.

Click Enable.




You have enabled the Learn365 xAPI connection in LinkedIn Learning.
